title: Block Movement / stack / 32011
description: Which sequence produces the entire final stack?
question: Use the 3 x 2 x 2 board. Each pair shows the same stack from opposite sides. Coordinates (x,y,z) follow the axes, starting at zero. Move the cube at the named current cell one unit. An occupied target swaps with the mover. An empty elevated target needs support immediately before the move. After each step, settle every column downward, preserving its order. Equal colors are interchangeable. Which sequence produces the entire final stack?

answer.explanation: gold (2, 1, 1) to (2, 0, 1). Then magenta (0, 1, 0) to (1, 1, 0), exchanging with gold. Then gold (0, 1, 1) to (0, 1, 0), exchanging with gold. Every displayed constraint matches.

options.label: A
options.explanation: magenta (0, 1, 0) to (1, 1, 0), exchanging with gold. Then blue (0, 0, 1) to (1, 0, 1). Then gold (2, 1, 1) to (2, 0, 1). Step 3, cell (0, 0, 1) contains empty. The panel requires blue.

options.label: B
options.explanation: blue (2, 0, 0) to (2, 0, 1), blue falls from (2, 0, 1) to (2, 0, 0). Then magenta (0, 1, 0) to (1, 1, 0), exchanging with gold. Then blue (2, 0, 0) to (2, 0, 1), blue falls from (2, 0, 1) to (2, 0, 0). Step 3, cell (2, 0, 1) contains empty. The panel requires gold.

options.label: C
options.explanation: gold (1, 1, 0) to (1, 1, 1), gold falls from (1, 1, 1) to (1, 1, 0). Then gold (1, 1, 0) to (0, 1, 0), exchanging with magenta. Then gold (2, 1, 1) to (1, 1, 1). Step 3, cell (1, 1, 1) contains gold. The panel requires empty.

options.label: D
options.explanation: gold (2, 1, 1) to (2, 0, 1). Then magenta (0, 1, 0) to (1, 1, 0), exchanging with gold. Then gold (0, 1, 1) to (0, 1, 0), exchanging with gold. Every displayed constraint matches.
